change.reason: Reassessed 2026-11-13 against 229bb9c. Open — 112 current evidence/scope findings across 90 records remain. Open — Athena/AIONix2 compatibility remains an edition-specific qualification commitment; the released Z80/CP-M and ERA/AIONix profile chronology is already defined.

Open evidence/applicability review — During dealer and demonstration preparation, select reference workflows and feedback from the preceding Autodesk beta programme, and carry unresolved qualification limits into the campaign materials.

Open evidence/applicability review — Run the coordinated previews, local dealer roadshows and Academy workshops through 31 March. Use AION-funded shared materials and capped partner matching funds, with absolute costs pending assessment; do not count promotional activity as automatic sales uplift.

chapters.description: Logix supplies one combined storage set containing the packaged ROM devices programmed or masked for {software_image}. chapters.chapter_name: Image installation, test and revision control
chapters.description: Freeze image revision, byte count, bank/lane files, checksum algorithm and expected verification values before mask generation or EPROM programming. The EPROM route needs specified programming voltage, pulse algorithm, verification, erasure/rework limits and cycle time; these are not assumed to match the host supply. A software revision requires assessed new masks or reprogramming, replacement stock and obsolete-stock handling.

For internal mask-ROM production, establish density-specific die area, usable dies per wafer, wafer route, probe/test flow and package before calculating cost. Cost estimates must state wafer/probe and assembly/final-test yield assumptions, mask/setup allocation, lot size, handling and test labour, scrap and rework. For purchased EPROMs use the qualified device quote plus programming and verification operations. Keep prices, changing yields, production volumes and amortisation assumptions in calculation evidence; do not add carrier, enclosure or software costs again.
